raw.details:
Overview

  • Location: KIET Deemed to be University, Muradnagar, Uttar Pradesh, India
  • Team Size: 1–3 members
  • Domain: Applied Research
  • Mode: Offline
  • Date: 06 October 2026
  • Reporting/Start Time: 09:45 AM IST onwards
  • Prize Money: Up to INR 15,000

Overview:

IDEAVERSE — IDEATHON 2026 is an offline ideathon designed to encourage students to identify real-world problems and develop innovative, practical, and technology-driven solutions.

The event will be conducted at KIET Deemed to be University, Ghaziabad.

Participants will present their ideas before a judging panel and demonstrate how their proposed solution can effectively address a real-world problem.

All That You Need to Know About IDEAVERSE — 2026:

Have an idea that can solve a real-world problem?

IDEAVERSE provides students with a platform to transform their thoughts into impactful solutions.

Participants will:

  • Identify a real-world problem.
  • Develop an innovative solution.
  • Explain the working and implementation of the proposed solution.
  • Present their idea before a panel of judges.
  • Answer questions from the judges.

The event focuses on:

  • Innovation
  • Problem-solving
  • Feasibility
  • Creativity
  • Real-world impact

Ideas may belong to domains such as:

  • Technology
  • Sustainability
  • Education
  • Healthcare
  • Smart Systems
  • Robotics
  • Applied Research
  • Any other relevant domain

Who Can Register / Participate:

  • Undergraduate students from any college are eligible to participate.
  • Intercollegiate teams are eligible.
  • Interdisciplinary teams are permitted.
  • Each team may have 1–3 participants.
  • One participant cannot be part of multiple teams.

Registration Process

Participants are required to complete the following registration process:

Step 1 — Register on Unstop

Participants must register for IDEAVERSE — IDEATHON 2026 through the official Unstop event page.

Step 2 — Fill the Google Form

After registering on Unstop, participants must fill out the official Google Form to complete their registration details.

Google Form Registration:

Registration Link

Note: Participants are requested to complete both steps to ensure successful registration.

Event Structure:

Ideathon Challenge:

The event will be conducted in a single offline round at KIET Deemed to be University, Ghaziabad.

Participants will be required to:

  • Identify a real-world problem.
  • Develop an innovative solution.
  • Explain the working and implementation of the proposed solution.
  • Present their idea before the judging panel.
  • Answer questions from the judges.

Participants may use the following to strengthen their presentation:

  • Technology
  • Research
  • Business models
  • Prototypes
  • Diagrams
  • Supporting material

Pitching Guidelines:

Each team will be given a limited amount of time to present their idea.

The presentation should clearly cover:

Problem Statement:

Clearly define the real-world problem being addressed.

Proposed Solution:

Explain the proposed solution and how it addresses the identified problem.

Innovation & Uniqueness:

Highlight what makes the idea innovative and different from existing solutions.

Working / Implementation:

Explain how the proposed solution will work and how it can be implemented in the real world.

Technology Used:

Mention the technologies, tools, platforms, or research involved.

Feasibility:

  • Explain whether the solution is technically and practically feasible.
  • Social / Environmental / Economic Impact:
  • Describe the potential impact of the solution.

Future Scope:

Explain how the solution can be improved, expanded, or scaled in the future.

Note: The exact presentation and questioning time will be communicated by the organising team.

Evaluation Criteria:

Teams may be evaluated based on:

  • Innovation & Creativity: Originality and creative approach of the idea.
  • Problem Identification: Relevance and clarity of the identified problem.
  • Technical Feasibility: Practicality of implementing the proposed technology.
  • Practical Implementation: Ability to implement the solution in real-world scenarios.
  • Impact & Scalability: Potential social, environmental, or economic impact and scalability.
  • Presentation & Communication: Clarity and effectiveness of the pitch.
  • Overall Potential of the Idea: Overall usefulness and potential of the proposed solution.

Event Details:

  • Date: 06 October 2026
  • Reporting/Start Time: 09:45 AM IST onwards
  • Mode: Offline
  • Venue: KIET Deemed to be University, Ghaziabad
  • Team Size: 1–3 participants
  • Prize Money: Up to INR 15,000

Rules and Regulations:

  • Participants must report to the venue before the designated reporting time.
  • Participants must carry a valid college ID card.
  • Each participant can be a member of only one team.
  • Teams must follow the instructions and time limits provided by the organising team.
  • Ideas presented should be original and should not knowingly violate intellectual-property rights.
  • Any form of unfair practice or misrepresentation may lead to disqualification.
  • Participants must maintain proper etiquette while interacting with organisers and judges.
  • The organising team reserves the right to modify event rules if required.
  • The decision of the judging panel and organising team regarding the final results will be considered final.
  • Further information and updates will be communicated through the official event communication channels.

Rewards:

Prize Money: Up to INR 15,000

All eligible participants will receive participation certificates as per the event's certificate policy.

Bring Your Idea. Build the Solution. Create the Impact.

Innovate • Ideate • Impact
